question: Should `optimizeImages` on outbound media loading and `maxDurationSeconds` on Opus transcoding become permanent reusable Plugin SDK contracts for this WhatsApp refactor?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically narrow, but these exported helper options define behavior available to other bundled and external plugins; code review cannot safely choose that long-term API direction.

options.title: Accept the shared contracts
options.body: Merge after confirming both options are generic media-helper behavior and retain the focused contract coverage.

options.title: Keep the behavior local
options.body: Rework the branch so WhatsApp preserves its channel-specific behavior without expanding the shared Plugin SDK APIs.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared contracts
recommendation.body: Merge after confirming both options are generic media-helper behavior and retain the focused contract coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available recent contributor for the WhatsApp behavior and can route the shared-contract decision to the relevant media API owner.
